title: Amazon.nl: used but functional item with condition-based deduction
facts_text: I received a portable Bluetooth speaker from Amazon.nl 18 days ago. I used it for 8 days and it works fine, but it has slight scratches and is not in perfect resale condition. It is complete and within the 30-day return window. I am requesting a partial refund to reflect that it has been used.
request: Please accept my return and refund EUR 45.50, reflecting a reasonable deduction for wear and use.

strict.reason: The item is within the return window and can be returned subject to reasonable condition-based deduction for use and wear.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The item is functional and still eligible for return, but normal wear justifies a proportionate partial refund.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: Condition-based deductions are permissible; discretion applies to the amount of the reduction for wear and use.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: This tests whether customer-initiated return is still permitted when the product is functional but has been used and shows ordinary wear.
